propositions: Natural fold on a ticket with an un-cited pre-snapshot orphan event retires the orphan file and cites its uuid in the new snapshot while the replay positional-skips its effect, causing repairable damage to become unrepairable and the ORPHAN_EVENT signal to be erased.

The fold enumeration must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events (orphans per fsck definition) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, deferring orphan absorption to the existing fsck repair door.
A shared is_snapshot_orphan predicate must be extracted and reused between compact_txn and fsck_scan to prevent the two code paths from disagreeing on orphan classification.

The fsck --repair-snapshots path must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing discipline that fsck --repair enforces, preventing blind unconditional rebuild past human-triage orphan types.

Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must be deferred from folding while their governing snapshot remains within the horizon, preventing a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT from being written and subsequently buried by the governing snapshot.
After a fold that excludes orphans, fsck must still report ORPHAN_EVENT findings and fsck --repair-snapshots must successfully restore orphan effects via full-log rebuild.
